decisions.question: What is the default scope of the search input?
options: Both library + external catalogs in one query
Library only — external search is a separate toggle
External only — library lives in its own filter view
decisions.selected: Both library + external catalogs in one query

decisions.question: How are results grouped on the search page?
options: Tabbed sections per media type (Books | Movies | TV | Games | Comics)
decisions.selected: Tabbed sections per media type (Books | Movies | TV | Games | Comics)

decisions.question: Where does the search input live?
options: Persistent global search bar in the top nav
decisions.selected: Persistent global search bar in the top nav

decisions.question: How does a user add an external result to their library?
options: Hover-revealed '+' button on each result card
Persistent 'add' button visible on every card
Click the card → modal with full details + add CTA
decisions.selected: Persistent 'add' button visible on every card

decisions.question: How do we query the four external catalogs (TMDB, IGDB, Open Library, Comic Vine)?
options: Parallel fan-out from the server with 800ms timeout per source
Sequential — query the most likely source first based on input heuristics
Client-side fan-out directly to each catalog API
decisions.selected: Parallel fan-out from the server with 800ms timeout per source

decisions.question: How do we cache external catalog responses?
options: Redis with 24h TTL keyed on (source, normalized-query)
No cache — every query hits the external API
decisions.selected: Redis with 24h TTL keyed on (source, normalized-query)
